question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Amazon)

calls.reasoning: Consensus GAAP EPS for Q3 2026 is ~$1.96-2.03 (45 analysts, range 1.72-2.23). Guidance: operating income $22.5-26.5B. Amazon usually beats, so ~$27B op income, ~19% tax and ~10.9B shares gives ~$2.0-2.1 core. Q1 ($2.78) and Q2 ($5.75) were inflated by Anthropic gains booked at funding-round prices (Series G/H); no priced Anthropic event was found in Jul-Sep 2026 (last round May at $965B; S-1 filed Oct 26, after the quarter). Notes are AFS, so their gains go to OCI. That leaves ~10% for an undisclosed Q3 priced event or Amazon draw on the $15B facility pushing EPS above $2.995. No human market found on Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold.

- Anthropic: Series H $65B at $965B post (May 2026); employee tender at $350B (Feb-Apr 2026); secondary indications ~$1.17T (Sep 2); IPO talk ~$2T; S-1 publicly filed Oct 26, 2026; roadshow no earlier than Nov 10. - Status quo: core EPS near consensus plus Amazon's typical beat, with no Anthropic mark.
- Searched but not found: any Q3 2026 Anthropic priced issuance or Amazon tranche; prediction markets (Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold) on Amazon Q3 EPS.
